files.name: motion-prompt-221.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Mind map" (マインドマップ), one of the names in "Diagrams and charts for slides".
Motion Prompt #221

What it is: Ideas branching out from a central topic
What the sample shows: Six curved branches grow from the central "テーマ" (topic) to both sides, then thinner twigs with small word nodes.
Spec:
- Center: a 100×44 px blue rounded box with white text "テーマ" (19 px), popping in at 0.4 s over 0.3 s (ease-out-back)
- Branches: six cubic Bézier curves (3 px), three to each side, growing over 0.5 s from 0.7 s, 0.09 s apart, each ending in a 54×24 px node; mid blue and gray alternate
- Twigs: thinner 2.5 px curves grow from the branch ends over 0.35 s (from 1.45 s), each ending in a small 40×18 px node
- Shape: curved branches and word nodes, unlike the nested rings of #240 Concentric circle diagram
- End: the whole figure fades out from 4.1 s to 4.5 s and the card stays empty until the 4.7 s loop
When to use it: For brainstorming, or to spread out and organize ideas around one topic.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/221.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/diagram.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
